title: Inventory account SKR04 source gate
purpose: Choose or block a source-backed SKR04-oriented inventory valuation account before any Item Posting Group or Inventory Posting Setup write.
entryCriteria: TARGET-047 result exists and selects this case.
TARGET-047 blocks Inventory Posting Setup because no inventory valuation account is selected.
The existing Universaarl starter account list has no released inventory valuation account.
acceptanceCriteria: A source-backed candidate inventory valuation account is selected, or the path is explicitly blocked.
The decision does not use CRONUS, RM-DEMO or old laboratory values as active target truth.
The decision distinguishes inventory balance account from purchase/material expense account.
No Business Central or Playwright execution occurs.
No G/L account, item posting group, item, setup, document, preview, posting or API change occurs.
The next case is either a narrow G/L account write/source gate or a narrow Item Posting Group write gate.

nextStepDecision.lastEvidenceSummary: TARGET-047 proved that Inventory Posting Setup needs an inventory account and that no current Universaarl starter account is released for inventory valuation.
nextStepDecision.reason: An Item Posting Group write is still premature because the selected inventory account 1140 is not yet created/proven in UNIVERSAARL-DE.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: Smallest write gate: create or verify 1140 as Bilanz/Buchung before inventory setup.
Needs Inventory Posting Group code and 1140 visible as inventory account.
O2C still waits for customer/item posting fields, VAT setup, general posting setup and inventory setup boundaries.
VAT remains a separate blocked foundation lane and should not be mixed with inventory account setup.

queueChangesMade: Keep TARGET-049, TARGET-050, O2C, Preview Posting and Posting locked.
nextStepDecision.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: It turns the source-backed account candidate into a visible Universaarl G/L account before any inventory posting setup row uses it.
risksBeforeNextCase: Do not claim SKR04 completeness or tax advisor approval.
Do not change Inventory Posting Setup in the same run.
Do not use 1140 for manufacturing finished goods without a separate goods/fertigwaren decision.
requiredPreparation: Open Chart of Accounts in playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
If missing and case unlocks it, create only 1140 Waren (Bestand) as Bilanz/Buchung with reopen proof.
Do not touch Item Posting Groups, Inventory Posting Setup, items, documents, Preview Posting or Posting.
